title: Mailbox/queryChanges: total field missing from response
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query_changes response (lines 315-325) does not include total. RFC 8620 §5.6 defines total as a response field. Email/queryChanges, Submission/queryChanges both include it from result.total. Mailbox backend provides total via QueryChangesResult but the handler discards it.
